title: Certificates of Deposit: reconciling Principal for a grace-period jumbo top-up
content:
## Scope

When the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate in its grace period asks to add just enough money for the certificate to earn the jumbo bonus when it renews, the top-up is measured against the certificate's Principal. This rule states how that Principal is reconciled for the purpose.

## Rule

1. **Reconciled from the ledger.** The Principal is reconciled from the certificate's own ledger as the sum of every deposit, plus every interest credit added by compounding, plus every penalty reversal credit, less every withdrawal, less every penalty.
2. **Interest paid out is excluded.** Interest payout entries are left out, because interest paid out never joined Principal.
3. **Reversals posted before measuring.** Every penalty reversal owed on the certificate is posted before the Shortfall below the jumbo threshold is measured, because a reversal credit is Principal and the jumbo bonus is judged on Principal.
4. **Same figure as at renewal.** This is the same reconciled Principal on which the jumbo test of every renewal is judged.

## Condition before the jumbo top-up is measured

Any penalty reversal owed on the certificate is already in its ledger when the jumbo shortfall is measured. Where that condition does not hold, the top-up is not measured.

## Worked reconciliation (hypothetical ledger)

| Ledger entry type | Hypothetical total | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Deposit entries | 96000.00 | Added |
| Interest compounding credits | 1850.00 | Added |
| Penalty reversal credits | 0.00 so far | Added |
| Withdrawal entries | 1500.00 | Taken off |
| Penalty entries | 120.00 | Taken off |
| Interest payout entries | 300.00 | Left out |

Reconciled Principal: 96000.00, plus 1850.00, less 1500.00, less 120.00, gives 96230.00.

## Why an owed reversal matters (same hypothetical ledger)

Suppose the 120.00 penalty was owed back. Once its reversal credit of 120.00 is posted, the reconciliation gives 96350.00, and the gap to the jumbo threshold is 120.00 smaller than it would have been had the gap been measured on 96230.00.

## Points of judgement

**Interest has been paid to the owner's savings account each month. Is it added back?**
No. Interest paid out never joined Principal and is left out.
